fields.default: A garden takes a year. We take it one season at a time.

fields.name: intro
fields.label: Intro
fields.default: Field & Hedge designs and plants around twelve gardens a year, all within an hour of Ludlow.

itemFields.label: Text
itemFields.default: What happens in this step, in a sentence or two.

default.title: Walk the ground in winter
default.text: We visit while the garden is bare and its bones show. You tell us what you would like to see from the kitchen window.

default.title: Draw the plan in spring
default.text: A hand-coloured planting plan arrives by post, with every tree, shrub and bulb listed beside its price.

default.title: Make the beds in summer
default.text: Paths are laid and soil is improved while the nursery grows your plants on.

default.title: Plant in October
default.text: Everything goes into the ground when roots settle best. We come back in May to see it wake up.
